The false alarm was retracted quickly by the same source. The onchain monitor (our own chain monitor) shows no signs of distress: no freezes (except rsETH which has been frozen since April — pre-existing, unrelated to USDC), liquidity idle $190M USDC.

So risk: low. Action: hold.

Should I consider elevated due to the earlier alert? The correction came from the same source 10 minutes later, explicitly retracting. The onchain data corroborates normalcy. Reacting to a retracted alert would be reacting to noise. Holding is correct.

- Onchain monitor shows normal operations: USDC utilization 91% with $190M idle liquidity, ample for exit; no new reserve freezes (rsETH frozen since April, pre-existing and unrelated).
- Governance activity is routine cap management (increases/reductions), no signs of distress touching USDC on Ethereum Core.
